'''François Trucy''' ({{IPA|fr|fʁɑ̃swa tʁysi|lang}}; 9 June 1931 – 25 March 2025) was a French politician who was a member of the [[Senate (France)|Senate]], representing the [[Var (department)|Var]] department. He was a member of the [[Union for a Popular Movement]]. 

Trucy died in [[Toulon]] on 25 March 2025, at the age of 93.<ref>[https://www.varmatin.com/politique/l-ancien-maire-de-toulon-francois-trucy-est-mort-a-l-age-de-93-ans-979418 L’ancien maire de Toulon François Trucy est mort à l’âge de 93 ans] {{in lang|fr}}</ref>
